title: PH60204: Physics And Technology Of Lasers
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Spontaneous and stimulated emission or radiation. Basic physics of lasing.
Practical examples of lasers: gas, ion, vapour, dye, excimer, and semiconductor
lasers. Applications in: science, industry, medicine, communications, defense,
printing etc.
